diffs.diff: pin count: part has 6 (SIG NC VCC GND VIN OUT), datasheet reading has 4 (SIG NC VCC GND)
diffs.evidence: The second reading listed only the 4-pin Grove connector, but the Seeed wiki for this exact board says 'There are two screw terminals on the board. One for outer power source and the other for device you want to control.', which the model represents as the VIN (supply) and OUT (load) pins in addition to SIG/NC/VCC/GND.
